name: Freewon China Co.,Ltd.
summary: Freewon China Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of precision metal parts in China and internationally. It offers 3C precision metal parts, including powder metallurgy parts, pin needle connector, and precision spring and leaf spring and automobile precision metal parts, such as shaped spring for headlights, fasteners for car sunroofs, precision spring and leaf spring for automobile sunroof, drive tube assembly, and sunroof drive pipe fittings.
